subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Gravity
description: Learn Data Gravity in one minute.

hook.text: Moving a petabyte of data to a new cloud takes weeks and costs a fortune. Data has gravity.

buildup.text: Data gravity means large datasets attract services and apps to them, not the other way around.

discovery.text: It's cheaper to move compute to the data than to move the data to the compute.

twist.text: Cloud providers know this. Free ingress, expensive egress — once your data is in, it stays.

climax.text: Data gravity is why cloud migrations are one-way trips for most companies.

punchline.text: Data sits still. Everything else moves to it.

quiz.question: What does 'data gravity' mean?
options: Large datasets attract services to them rather than being moved
Databases slow down as they grow
